full_judgment:
Civil Revision No.96 of 1990 (Sylhet) discharging the Rule obtained against the judgment and order dated August 27, 1990 of the Court of District Judge, Moulvibazar in Miscellaneous Appeal No.I7 of 1984 reversing the judgment and order dated June 27, 1984 of the Court of Subordinate Judge (now Joint District Judge). Moulvibazar in Miscellaneous Case No. 70 of 1982 allowing the same. The Miscellaneous case was filed under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act on January 15, 1982 seeking pre-emption of the transfer made by the kabala dated December 22, 1980. 

 7. In that state of the matter we are of the view High Court Division did not commit any error in discharging the 'Rule on the finding that the appellate Court was quite correct that the Miscellaneous Case was barred by limitation.
